clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested hi me 
by section 1  of the act of August 1,1914, 
38 Stat. 609, 623 (U.S.C., title 19, sec. 2), 
it is ordered that the designation of 
Gastonia, North Carolina, as a customs 
port of entry in Customs Collection Dis­
trict Number 15 (North Carolina), be, 
and it is hereby, revoked, effective this 
date.
